<style>
/* ---------- Tokens (matched to the control panel) ---------- */
.bcc{
  --bcc-text:#313440;
  --bcc-muted:#5E637A;
  --bcc-faint:#8A8FA8;
  --bcc-border:#D9DCE9;
  --bcc-line:#EEF0F6;
  --bcc-blue:#3C64F4;
  --bcc-purple:#8A5CF7;
  --bcc-bubble:#F0F3FF;
  --bcc-chip:#E7EAF5;
  --bcc-green:#2A8A4E;
  --bcc-red:#DB3643;
  --bcc-chart-a:#7B58B8;
  --bcc-chart-b:#6FC7BB;
  /* Intro animation timings — edit here. All of them (delays AND durations) are multiplied by
     --bcc-i-speed, so changing that one number stretches or compresses the whole sequence while every
     step keeps its position relative to the others — set it from BCC_CONFIG.intro.speed, or live from
     the "Full animation length" slider in the tuning panel below. */
  --bcc-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);   /* expo-out: fast start, soft landing */
  --bcc-i-speed:1;                       /* 1 = baseline pace below; 1.25 = 25% slower; 0.8 = 20% faster */

  --bcc-i-frame:1000ms;                  /* frame expands 0 → 100% width (this is also its own duration) */

  --bcc-i-head:480ms;                    /* delay: header slides down (starts while frame is still landing) */
  --bcc-d-head-t:550ms; --bcc-d-head-o:400ms;         /* its transform/opacity durations */

  --bcc-i-composer:900ms;                /* delay: input box rises from the bottom */
  --bcc-d-composer-t:600ms; --bcc-d-composer-o:450ms;

  --bcc-i-orb:820ms;                     /* delay: orb scales in */
  --bcc-d-orb-t:800ms; --bcc-d-orb-o:500ms;

  --bcc-i-greet:960ms;                   /* delay: "Hello, I'm here to help" */
  --bcc-i-copy:1060ms;                   /* delay: two-line intro copy */
  --bcc-i-chips:1160ms;                  /* delay: first prompt chip … */
  --bcc-i-chip-step:90ms;                /* … then each following chip */
  --bcc-i-new:1560ms;                    /* delay: "What's new" link */
  --bcc-d-item-t:550ms; --bcc-d-item-o:450ms;         /* shared transform/opacity durations for all of the above */

  --bcc-cue-height:90vh;                 /* height of the prototype-only scroll prompt above the window — overridden by BCC_CONFIG.intro.cueHeight at load, and by the panel below */
  --bcc-window-height:680px;             /* height of the chat window itself — overridden by BCC_CONFIG.windowHeight and the panel below */
  font-family:'Source Sans 3','Source Sans Pro',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  color:var(--bcc-text);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  max-width:1200px;
  margin:0 auto;
  text-align:left;
}
.bcc *,.bcc *::before,.bcc *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.bcc h2,.bcc h3,.bcc h4,.bcc h5,.bcc p,.bcc ul,.bcc ol,.bcc figure{margin:0;padding:0}
.bcc button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer}
.bcc button:focus-visible,.bcc a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--bcc-blue);outline-offset:2px}
.bcc svg{display:block}
.bcc-data{display:none}

/* ---------- Window / panes ---------- */
.bcc-window{
  position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:var(--bcc-window-height);margin:0 auto;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bcc-border);border-radius:6px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 36px rgba(49,52,64,.14);overflow:hidden;
}
.bcc-frame{display:flex;width:100%;height:100%}

/* Workspace pane (left) */
.bcc-ws{
  flex:0 0 0px;width:0;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;
  border-right:1px solid transparent;
  transition:flex-basis .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),border-color .45s;
}
.bcc-window.ws-open .bcc-ws{flex-basis:58%;width:58%;border-right-color:var(--bcc-border)}
.bcc-ws-inner{min-width:520px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bcc-ws-head{
  flex:0 0 auto;height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-border);font-size:20px;
}
.bcc-ws-head .bcc-ws-title{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.bcc-ws-close{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--bcc-text);font-size:16px;flex:0 0 auto;margin-left:16px}
.bcc-ws-close svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:currentColor}
.bcc-ws-close .bcc-ws-back{display:none}
.bcc-ws-body{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto}

/* Chat pane (right) */
.bcc-chat{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff}
.bcc-head{
  flex:0 0 auto;height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-border);
}
.bcc-head h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.bcc-head-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;color:var(--bcc-muted)}
.bcc-head-actions svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:currentColor}
/* "More" dropdown */
.bcc-menu{position:relative;display:flex}
.bcc .bcc-menu-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--bcc-muted);transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.bcc .bcc-menu-btn:hover{background:var(--bcc-bubble);color:var(--bcc-text)}
.bcc .bcc-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--bcc-text);color:#fff}
.bcc-menu-list{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;z-index:20;min-width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bcc-border);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(49,52,64,.16);overflow:hidden}
.bcc-menu-list[hidden]{display:none}
.bcc .bcc-menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:14px 18px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--bcc-text);text-align:left;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s}
.bcc .bcc-menu-item:hover{background:#F7F8FC}
.bcc .bcc-menu-item + .bcc-menu-item{border-top:1px solid var(--bcc-border)}
.bcc .bcc-menu-item--cta{color:var(--bcc-blue);background:var(--bcc-bubble)}
.bcc .bcc-menu-item--cta:hover{background:var(--bcc-chip)}
.bcc-menu-item svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto;fill:currentColor}
.bcc-menu-item .bcc-stars{fill:none;stroke:currentColor}

.bcc-scroll{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto;padding:24px 24px 36px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#C9CDDD transparent}
.bcc-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
.bcc-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#C9CDDD;border-radius:4px}

/* ---------- Welcome state ---------- */
.bcc-welcome{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;
  padding:28px 8px 16px;transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .35s ease;
}
.bcc-welcome.is-gone{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px);pointer-events:none}
.bcc-welcome[hidden]{display:none}

.bcc-orb{
  position:relative;width:162px;height:152px;border-radius:50%;margin-bottom:6px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#D4F86A 0%,#CBF56C 20%,#A6B7F0 36%,#7A78F6 52%,#6260F3 70%,#5B58F1 86%,rgba(91,88,241,.6) 96%,rgba(91,88,241,0) 100%);
  filter:blur(1.2px);
  box-shadow:0 26px 40px -12px rgba(91,88,241,.6);
}
.bcc-orb::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(91,88,241,.32),rgba(91,88,241,0) 70%);
  z-index:-1;filter:blur(10px);
}
.bcc-orb img{display:none;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:50%}
.bcc-orb.has-img{background:none;box-shadow:none;filter:none}
.bcc-orb.has-img::after{display:none}
.bcc-orb.has-img img{display:block}

.bcc-welcome h2{font-size:28px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:16px}
.bcc-welcome p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:22px}
.bcc-chips{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bcc-whatsnew{display:none;margin-top:24px;color:var(--bcc-blue);font-size:18px;text-decoration:none}   /* hidden — set back to inline-block to restore */
.bcc-whatsnew:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* Prompt chip — pill with purple→blue gradient border */
.bcc .bcc-chip{
  position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  padding:8px 14px 8px 12px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1.5px solid transparent;
  background-image:linear-gradient(#fff,#fff),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bcc-purple),var(--bcc-blue));
  background-origin:border-box;background-clip:padding-box,border-box;
  font-size:18px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--bcc-text);text-align:left;
  transition:background-image .15s,transform .15s;
}
.bcc .bcc-chip:hover{background-image:linear-gradient(#F4F6FF,#F4F6FF),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bcc-purple),var(--bcc-blue))}
.bcc .bcc-chip:active{transform:scale(.985)}
.bcc .bcc-chip.is-used{opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.bcc-chip svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:var(--bcc-blue);flex:0 0 auto}
.bcc-chip .bcc-chev{width:22px;height:22px}
.bcc-chip--sm{font-size:15px;padding:6px 10px 6px 9px;gap:6px}
.bcc-chip--sm svg{width:18px;height:18px}

/* ---------- Thread ---------- */
.bcc-thread{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px}
.bcc-user{
  align-self:flex-end;max-width:82%;background:var(--bcc-bubble);
  border-radius:16px;padding:12px 20px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;
}
.bcc-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#6B6F8C;font-size:18px;min-height:28px}
.bcc-dots{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}
.bcc-dots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#8B90B0;opacity:.35;animation:bccDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.bcc-dots i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}
.bcc-dots i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}
@keyframes bccDot{0%,100%{opacity:.3;transform:translateY(0)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-1px)}}
.bcc-status-text{transition:opacity .25s}
.bcc-status-text.is-swap{opacity:0}

.bcc-msg{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.bcc .bcc-msg>*+*{margin-top:14px}
.bcc-msg h4{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;margin-top:22px}
.bcc-msg h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.bcc-msg ul,.bcc-msg ol{padding-left:26px}
.bcc-msg li+li{margin-top:6px}
.bcc-msg strong{font-weight:600}
.bcc-msg em{font-style:italic}
.bcc-msg a{color:var(--bcc-blue)}

/* Table (analytics answer) */
.bcc-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
.bcc-table th{text-align:left;font-weight:600;padding:8px 8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-border);white-space:nowrap}
.bcc-table td{padding:10px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-line);vertical-align:top}
.bcc-table th.num,.bcc-table td.num{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.bcc-table .bcc-sku{display:block;color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.bcc-up{color:var(--bcc-green);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.bcc-down{color:var(--bcc-red);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}

/* Chart artifact card in chat */
.bcc-artifact{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid var(--bcc-border);border-radius:6px;
  padding:20px 22px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;
}
.bcc-artifact:hover{border-color:#B9BFD6;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(49,52,64,.08)}
.bcc-artifact-icon{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bcc-blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.bcc-artifact-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:#fff}
.bcc-artifact-title{display:block;font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.bcc-artifact-sub{display:block;color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:16px;margin-top:4px}

/* Product cards */
.bcc-products{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.bcc-product{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid var(--bcc-border);border-radius:6px;
  padding:16px 18px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);
  transition:opacity .4s ease,transform .4s ease,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;
}
.bcc-product.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.bcc-product:hover{border-color:#B9BFD6;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(49,52,64,.08)}
.bcc-product-img{
  width:84px;height:84px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:4px;background:#F3F4F9;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
}
.bcc-product-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.bcc-product-img svg{width:34px;height:34px;fill:#C3C7D9}
.bcc-product-img.has-img svg{display:none}
.bcc-product-body{display:block;min-width:0}
.bcc-product h5{display:block}
.bcc-product h5{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.bcc-product-sku{display:block;color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:16px;margin-top:4px}
.bcc-product-meta{display:block;font-size:17px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--bcc-muted)}
.bcc-product-meta strong{color:var(--bcc-text);font-weight:600;margin-right:8px}
.bcc-product-meta .bcc-dotsep{margin-right:8px}
.bcc-stock-low::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#F2A73B;margin:0 6px 1px 0;vertical-align:middle}

.bcc-pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:14px;color:var(--bcc-text);font-size:17px;padding:14px 4px 4px;border-top:1px solid var(--bcc-line)}
.bcc-pager svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:currentColor}
.bcc-pager .is-dim{color:#B9BFD6}

/* Feedback icons */
.bcc-feedback{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:16px}
.bcc-feedback button{color:var(--bcc-muted);display:flex;position:relative;transition:color .15s}
.bcc-feedback button:hover{color:var(--bcc-blue)}
.bcc-feedback button.is-active{color:var(--bcc-blue)}
.bcc-feedback svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:currentColor}
.bcc-feedback .bcc-tip{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-30px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--bcc-text);color:#fff;font-size:12px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s}
.bcc-feedback .bcc-tip.is-on{opacity:1}

.bcc .bcc-action{margin-top:2px;align-self:flex-start}

/* Follow-up row */
.bcc-followup{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--bcc-line)}
.bcc-followup-label{width:100%;color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:-2px}
.bcc .bcc-startover{color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:15px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;margin-left:auto}
.bcc-startover:hover{color:var(--bcc-blue)}

/* Generic fade-in helper */
.bcc-fade{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .35s ease}
.bcc-fade.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- Composer ---------- */
.bcc-composer{flex:0 0 auto;padding:14px 24px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--bcc-border);position:relative}
.bcc-input{border:1px solid var(--bcc-border);border-radius:6px;padding:16px 16px 12px;cursor:text;transition:border-color .15s}
.bcc-input:hover{border-color:#B9BFD6}
.bcc-placeholder{color:var(--bcc-faint);font-size:19px;line-height:1.3}
.bcc-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:22px}
.bcc-ctx{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--bcc-chip);border-radius:4px;padding:5px 11px 5px 8px;font-size:17px}
.bcc-ctx svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.bcc-send{width:26px;height:26px;fill:#B3B7CB;margin-right:4px}
.bcc-hint{position:absolute;left:24px;right:24px;bottom:4px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--bcc-muted);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.bcc-hint.is-in{opacity:1}

/* ---------- Workspace: chart ---------- */
.bcc-ws-body.is-center{display:flex;align-items:center}
.bcc-chart-wrap{padding:24px 36px;width:100%}
.bcc-chart-wrap svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.bcc-chart text{font-family:inherit}
.bcc-bar{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.bcc-chart.is-in .bcc-bar{transform:scaleX(1)}
.bcc-val{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease}
.bcc-chart.is-in .bcc-val{opacity:1}

/* ---------- Workspace: product detail ---------- */
.bcc-detail{padding:28px 32px 32px;font-size:17px}
.bcc-detail-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,38%) 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:start;padding-bottom:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-border)}
.bcc-detail-img{aspect-ratio:1/1;background:#F3F4F9;border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.bcc-detail-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.bcc-detail-img svg{width:64px;height:64px;fill:#C3C7D9}
.bcc-detail-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}
.bcc-detail-title h3{font-size:27px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.25}
.bcc-badge{flex:0 0 auto;background:#2F8A47;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:6px}
.bcc-detail-sku{color:var(--bcc-muted);font-size:17px;margin-top:8px}
.bcc-detail-price{font-size:30px;font-weight:600;margin-top:22px}
.bcc-detail-section{padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bcc-border)}
.bcc-detail-section h4{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px}
.bcc-detail-section p{line-height:1.55}
.bcc-kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;row-gap:10px;column-gap:16px}
.bcc-kv dt{color:var(--bcc-muted)}
.bcc-kv dd{margin:0}
.bcc-detail-foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding-top:22px}
.bcc-detail-foot a{color:var(--bcc-blue);text-decoration:none;font-size:18px}
.bcc-detail-foot a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* ---------- Scroll-trigger tuning panel (PROTOTYPE ONLY — remove before production) ---------- */
.bcc-panel{
  position:fixed;top:20px;right:20px;z-index:1000;width:236px;
  font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:#313440;
}
.bcc .bcc-panel-toggle{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #D9DCE9;border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(49,52,64,.16);padding:10px 14px;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#313440;cursor:pointer;
}
.bcc .bcc-panel-toggle svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:#5E637A;flex:0 0 auto;transition:transform .3s ease}
.bcc .bcc-panel-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] svg{transform:rotate(75deg)}
.bcc .bcc-panel-toggle:hover{border-color:#B9BFD6}
.bcc-panel-body{
  margin-top:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #D9DCE9;border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(49,52,64,.16);padding:16px 18px;
  transform-origin:top right;
}
.bcc-panel-note{font-size:11px;color:#8A8FA8;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:14px}
.bcc-panel-row{display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.bcc-panel-row span{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;color:#5E637A}
.bcc-panel-row b{color:#313440;font-weight:600}
.bcc-panel-row input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#3C64F4;cursor:pointer}
.bcc .bcc-panel-reset{width:100%;background:#F0F3FF;border:1px solid #D9DCE9;border-radius:5px;padding:7px 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#3C64F4;cursor:pointer}
.bcc .bcc-panel-reset:hover{background:#E7EAF5}
.bcc-panel-divider{height:1px;background:#EEF0F6;margin:16px 0}
.bcc-panel-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer}
.bcc-panel-check input{accent-color:#3C64F4;width:15px;height:15px;flex:0 0 auto;cursor:pointer}
.bcc-panel-check span{color:#5E637A;font-size:13px}
.bcc-switch-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px}
.bcc-switch-row span{color:#5E637A;font-size:13px}
.bcc-switch{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:36px;height:21px;flex:0 0 auto}

        card.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); openProduct(card); } });
      });
    }
    if (clone.getAttribute('data-open') === 'chart') {
      clone.addEventListener('click', function () { openChart(); });
      clone.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); openChart(); } });
    }
  }
  function applyProductImage(card) {
    var url = card.getAttribute('data-img');
    if (!url) { return; }
    var box = card.querySelector('.bcc-product-img');
    if (!box || box.querySelector('img')) { return; }
    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = url; img.alt = '';
    box.appendChild(img);
    box.classList.add('has-img');
  }

  function addFeedback(msg) {
    var f = el('div', 'bcc-feedback');
    var copy = el('button', '', ICON.copy + '<span class="bcc-tip">Copied</span>');
    copy.type = 'button'; copy.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy response');
    copy.addEventListener('click', function () {
      try { navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText(msg.innerText); } catch (e) { /* no-op */ }
      var tip = copy.querySelector('.bcc-tip');
      tip.classList.add('is-on');
      setTimeout(function () { tip.classList.remove('is-on'); }, 1200);
    });
    var up = el('button', '', ICON.up), down = el('button', '', ICON.down);
    up.type = 'button'; down.type = 'button';
    up.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Good response'); down.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Bad response');
    up.addEventListener('click', function () { up.classList.toggle('is-active'); down.classList.remove('is-active'); });
    down.addEventListener('click', function () { down.classList.toggle('is-active'); up.classList.remove('is-active'); });
    f.appendChild(copy); f.appendChild(up); f.appendChild(down);
    appendFade(msg, f);
  }

  function removeFollowup() {
    var old = thread.querySelector('.bcc-followup');
    if (old) { old.parentNode.removeChild(old); }
  }
  function addFollowup() {
    var remaining = order.filter(function (k) { return !used[k]; });
    var row = el('div', 'bcc-followup');
    if (remaining.length) {
      row.appendChild(el('div', 'bcc-followup-label', 'Try another question'));
      remaining.forEach(function (k) {
        row.appendChild(makeChip(prompts[k].question, function () { ask(k); }, true));
      });
    }
    var so = el('button', 'bcc-startover', 'Start over');
    so.type = 'button';
    so.addEventListener('click', startOver);
    row.appendChild(so);
    appendFade(thread, row);
  }
  function startOver() {
    if (busy) { return; }
    thread.innerHTML = '';
    used = {};
    closeWorkspace();
    showWelcome();
  }

  /* ---------- Main flow: a prompt is selected ---------- */
  function ask(key) {
    var p = prompts[key];
    if (!p || busy) { return; }
    busy = true; used[key] = true;
    removeFollowup();
    closeWorkspace();
    var msg;
    hideWelcome()
      .then(function () { addUser(p.question); return wait(350); })
      .then(function () { return runStatus(p.steps); })
      .then(function () {
        msg = el('div', 'bcc-msg');
        thread.appendChild(msg);
        return streamNode(p.el, msg);
      })
      .then(function () {
        if (p.workspace === 'chart') { return wait(450).then(openChart); }
      })
      .then(function () { return wait(250); })
      .then(function () {
        addFeedback(msg);
        if (p.action) {
          return wait(320).then(function () {
            var chip = makeChip(p.action, function () { chip.classList.add('is-used'); navigate(p); });
            chip.classList.add('bcc-action');
            appendFade(thread, chip);
          });
        }
      })
      .then(function () { return wait(650); })
      .then(function () { addFollowup(); busy = false; })
      .catch(function () { busy = false; });
  }

  /* ---------- "Go to …" chip — this is a marketing-site demo, so it never actually navigates anywhere.
     Any prompt's data-action chip lands here and gets the same canned demo-limitation reply, personalized
     with the destination name. Edit DEMO_LINKS below to change the login / trial URLs it points to. ---------- */
  var DEMO_LINKS = {
    login: 'https://login.bigcommerce.com/login',
    trial: 'https://www.bigcommerce.com/free-trial'
  };
/* ---------- Header "more" dropdown ---------- */
var menu = $('bcc-menu'), menuBtn = $('bcc-menu-btn'), menuList = $('bcc-menu-list');
function setMenu(open) {
  menuList.hidden = !open;
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
}
$('bcc-menu-trial').href = DEMO_LINKS.trial;
menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); setMenu(menuList.hidden); });
$('bcc-menu-new').addEventListener('click', function () { setMenu(false); startOver(); });
$('bcc-menu-trial').addEventListener('click', function () { setMenu(false); });
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!menu.contains(e.target)) { setMenu(false); } });
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && !menuList.hidden) { setMenu(false); menuBtn.focus(); }
});
  function navigate(p) {
    if (busy) { return; }
    busy = true;
    removeFollowup();
    closeWorkspace();
    var msg;
    Promise.resolve()
      .then(function () { addUser(p.action); return wait(350); })
      .then(function () { return runStatus(['Understanding your request']); })
      .then(function () {
        msg = el('div', 'bcc-msg');
        thread.appendChild(msg);
        var src = el('div');
        var lead = el('p');
        lead.innerHTML = 'Sure thing! I’m only a demo chat though, so I can’t actually open <strong></strong> here. ' +
          'You can <a href="' + DEMO_LINKS.login + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">log in to your store</a> or ' +
          '<a href="' + DEMO_LINKS.trial + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">start a free trial</a> to give the real version of me a try.';
        lead.querySelector('strong').textContent = p.actionDest || 'that';
        src.appendChild(lead);
        return streamNode(src, msg);
      })
      .then(function () { return wait(250); })
      .then(function () { addFeedback(msg); return wait(600); })
      .then(function () { addFollowup(); busy = false; })
      .catch(function () { busy = false; });
  }

  /* ---------- Workspace pane ---------- */
  function openWorkspace(title) {
    wsTitle.textContent = title;
    var wasOpen = win.classList.contains('ws-open');
    win.classList.add('ws-open');
    ws.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    return wait(wasOpen ? 60 : 480);
  }
  function closeWorkspace() {
    win.classList.remove('ws-open');
    ws.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  function openChart() {
    wsBody.innerHTML = '';
    wsBody.classList.add('is-center');
    var wrap = el('div', 'bcc-chart-wrap');
    var svg = buildChart(BCC_CHART);
    wrap.appendChild(svg);
    wsBody.appendChild(wrap);
    return openWorkspace(BCC_CHART.title).then(function () {
      void svg.getBoundingClientRect();
      svg.classList.add('is-in');
    });
  }

  function fmtMoney(n) { return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
  function fmtTick(n) { return n === 0 ? '$0' : '$' + (n / 1000) + 'k'; }

  function buildChart(data) {
    var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    var W = 720, H = 560, padL = 205, padR = 82, top = 104, bottom = 56;
    var n = data.rows.length, rowH = (H - top - bottom) / n, barH = 24, gap = 6;
    var max = 0;
    data.rows.forEach(function (r) { max = Math.max(max, r.current, r.previous); });
    var step = 2000, tickMax = Math.ceil(max / step) * step;
    var plotW = W - padL - padR, x = function (v) { return padL + (v / tickMax) * plotW; };

    var svg = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H);
    svg.setAttribute('class', 'bcc-chart');
    svg.setAttribute('role', 'img');
    svg.setAttribute('aria-label', data.title + ' — ' + data.currentLabel + ' vs ' + data.previousLabel);

    function mk(tag, attrs, text) {
      var e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
      for (var k in attrs) { e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); }
      if (text != null) { e.textContent = text; }
      svg.appendChild(e);
      return e;
    }

    // Title + legend
    mk('text', { x: W / 2, y: 42, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 24, 'font-weight': 600, fill: '#313440' }, data.title);
    var legY = 72, lw = 26, lh = 15;
    var l1 = data.currentLabel, l2 = data.previousLabel;
    var approx = function (s) { return s.length * 7.6; };
    var totalLeg = lw + 8 + approx(l1) + 24 + lw + 8 + approx(l2);
    var lx = W / 2 - totalLeg / 2;
    mk('rect', { x: lx, y: legY - lh + 3, width: lw, height: lh, rx: 4, fill: '#7B58B8' });
    mk('text', { x: lx + lw + 8, y: legY, 'font-size': 14, fill: '#313440' }, l1);
    lx += lw + 8 + approx(l1) + 24;
    mk('rect', { x: lx, y: legY - lh + 3, width: lw, height: lh, rx: 4, fill: '#6FC7BB' });
    mk('text', { x: lx + lw + 8, y: legY, 'font-size': 14, fill: '#313440' }, l2);

    // Gridlines + x ticks
    for (var v = 0; v <= tickMax; v += step) {
      var gx = x(v);
      mk('line', { x1: gx, y1: top, x2: gx, y2: H - bottom, stroke: v === 0 ? '#5E637A' : '#EEF0F6', 'stroke-width': 1 });
      mk('text', { x: gx, y: H - bottom + 24, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 13, fill: '#5E637A' }, fmtTick(v));
    }

    // Rows
    data.rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      var rowTop = top + i * rowH, cy = rowTop + rowH / 2;
      var groupH = barH * 2 + gap, y1 = cy - groupH / 2, y2 = y1 + barH + gap;

      // Label (wrap to two lines if long)
      var label = mk('text', { x: padL - 14, y: cy, 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': 16, fill: '#5E637A' });
      var words = r.label.split(' ');
      if (r.label.length > 18 && words.length > 1) {
        var mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2);
        var t1 = document.createElementNS(NS, 'tspan'); t1.setAttribute('x', padL - 14); t1.setAttribute('dy', '-0.35em'); t1.textContent = words.slice(0, mid).join(' ');
        var t2 = document.createElementNS(NS, 'tspan'); t2.setAttribute('x', padL - 14); t2.setAttribute('dy', '1.15em'); t2.textContent = words.slice(mid).join(' ');
        label.appendChild(t1); label.appendChild(t2);
      } else {
        label.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'middle');
        label.textContent = r.label;
      }

      var delay = (i * 90) + 'ms';
      var b1 = mk('rect', { class: 'bcc-bar', x: padL, y: y1, width: Math.max(0, x(r.current) - padL), height: barH, rx: 2, fill: '#7B58B8' });
      b1.style.transitionDelay = delay;
      var b2 = mk('rect', { class: 'bcc-bar', x: padL, y: y2, width: Math.max(0, x(r.previous) - padL), height: barH, rx: 2, fill: '#6FC7BB' });
      b2.style.transitionDelay = delay;
      var v1 = mk('text', { class: 'bcc-val', x: x(r.current) + 8, y: y1 + barH / 2, 'dominant-baseline': 'middle', 'font-size': 14, fill: '#313440' }, fmtMoney(r.current));
      v1.style.transitionDelay = (i * 90 + 700) + 'ms';
      var v2 = mk('text', { class: 'bcc-val', x: x(r.previous) + 8, y: y2 + barH / 2, 'dominant-baseline': 'middle', 'font-size': 14, fill: '#5E637A' }, fmtMoney(r.previous));
      v2.style.transitionDelay = (i * 90 + 700) + 'ms';
    });
    return svg;
  }

  function openProduct(card) {
    wsBody.classList.remove('is-center');
    var name = card.getAttribute('data-name') || '', sku = card.getAttribute('data-sku') || '',
        price = card.getAttribute('data-price') || '', stock = card.getAttribute('data-stock') || '',
        low = card.getAttribute('data-low') || '', desc = card.getAttribute('data-desc') || '',
        img = card.getAttribute('data-img') || '';
    wsBody.innerHTML = '';
    var d = el('div', 'bcc-detail');
    d.innerHTML =
      '<div class="bcc-detail-top">' +
        '<div class="bcc-detail-img">' + (img ? '<img alt="">' : ICON.box) + '</div>' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div class="bcc-detail-title"><h3></h3><span class="bcc-badge">VISIBLE</span></div>' +
          '<div class="bcc-detail-sku"></div>' +
          '<div class="bcc-detail-price"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="bcc-detail-section"><h4>Description</h4><p></p></div>' +
      '<div class="bcc-detail-section"><h4>Pricing</h4><dl class="bcc-kv">' +
        '<dt>Default price</dt><dd class="bcc-kv-price"></dd>' +
        '<dt>Sale price</dt><dd>—</dd><dt>Cost</dt><dd>—</dd><dt>MSRP</dt><dd>—</dd><dt>Tax class</dt><dd>Default</dd>' +
      '</dl></div>' +
      '<div class="bcc-detail-section"><h4>Inventory</h4><dl class="bcc-kv">' +
        '<dt>Tracking level</dt><dd>Product</dd>' +
        '<dt>Current stock</dt><dd class="bcc-kv-stock"></dd>' +
        '<dt>Low stock level</dt><dd class="bcc-kv-low"></dd>' +
      '</dl></div>' +
      '<div class="bcc-detail-foot"><a href="#" onclick="return false;">Open in admin</a></div>';
    d.querySelector('h3').textContent = name;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-detail-sku').textContent = 'SKU: ' + sku;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-detail-price').textContent = price;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-detail-section p').textContent = desc;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-kv-price').textContent = price;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-kv-stock').textContent = stock;
    d.querySelector('.bcc-kv-low').textContent = low;
    if (img) { d.querySelector('.bcc-detail-img img').src = img; }
    wsBody.appendChild(d);
    openWorkspace(name);
  }
})();
</script>

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
